title: Overview
text: Twap Hunter is a FastAPI research terminal and bot for Polymarket 5-minute crypto Up/Down markets XRP BTC ETH SOL DOGE. Paper bots on /bots simulate fills against the live CLOB book. Real bots on /real send FOK market orders only after explicit Start. Copy Trader is not supported on real (error copy_trader not supported on real yet). Telegram, daily loss limit, STOP file, FAK toggle, and percent take-profit are not implemented. State is SQLite in data/ or DATA_DIR. Private keys are Fernet-encrypted; data/.encryption_key is required to decrypt. Trading can lose the deposited balance.

title: Install Linux
text: Use Python 3.12. From project root: python3.12 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; cp .env.example .env; set SITE_PASSWORD; .venv/bin/python -m backend. Default bind 0.0.0.0 port PORT or 8010. Empty SITE_PASSWORD disables dashboard auth. No systemd unit is shipped. scripts/keep_alive.py is Windows-only. Outbound HTTPS/WSS to Binance and Polymarket required. Optional Docker: python -u -m backend, PYTHONPATH=/app, expose 8080.

title: Install Windows
text: PowerShell from project root. Port 8010 may be in a Windows excluded range; use 9000. Commands: py -3.12 -m venv .venv; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt; Copy-Item .env.example .env; uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9000. Use the venv Python so polymarket-client is 0.13+. Duplicate bind causes WinError 10048. Optional scripts/keep_alive.py hardcoded to port 8010. Docker WSL NSSM are not required.

title: Configuration
text: Environment: SITE_PASSWORD, SESSION_SECRET defaults to SITE_PASSWORD, POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY for PolyBolt if no stored account, optional POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_KEY SECRET PASSPHRASE together, DATA_DIR default repo/data, PORT default 8010, FORCE_SECURE_COOKIES, RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT. .env fills only unset keys. POLYMARKET_API_KEY SECRET PASSPHRASE are not read by the server. Timing lives in backend/config.py. Paper settings gear edits strategy params; real card LOT edits order_usd only. Restart after .env changes.

title: Strategies
text: Evaluators in backend/engine/bots.py: twap_lockin, twap_lockin_cut, winning_hold, cross_line, next_round_scalp, copy_trader, dip_harvester, pressure_scalp, momentum_rider, cross_hunter. Shared rules: 250 ms loop, taker fee 0.07 * shares * min(p,1-p), skip first 2s and last 5s of the round, skip spread over 20 cents, min 1 share, sell if bid at least 99 cents. copy_trader live disabled. pressure_scalp catalog text notes 0W/11L live testing. dip_harvester buys both UP and DOWN on dips. Real bots reuse the same evaluators.

title: Operation flow
text: Start python -m backend, load .env, FastAPI, pipelines on demand. Real loop: reconcile pending_op, settle when window rolls without flatten POST, 99 cent lock sell, then strategy. FOK persist-before-send. Fill proof is get_order and trades, not cash. No CLOB POST retry. Redeem about every 20s batch 5 by condition_id. Feeds reconnect backoff 500 1000 2000 5000 ms. No Telegram. No STOP file. Stop via UI or process exit.

title: Paper trading
text: Paper bots at /bots simulate fills against the live book. Fresh DB seeds BTC Lock In Small Loss strategy twap_lockin_cut. Copy Trader paper uses activity websocket and can book non-crypto trades into a paper portfolio. Paper STOP may simulate flatten. Settlement credits paper balance. PolyBolt TWAP still needs POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY or a stored account.

title: Live trading
text: Live at /real. Add account with private key, import paper bot, press Start. Orders are FOK. BUY amount is full order_usd at best ask only. Geoblock returns Trading restricted in your region. Settlement does not flatten-sell leftovers. Redeem converts winning tokens to pUSD; losers redeem to 0. Card Open PnL is Data API wallet mark for the asset, shared by bots on that account. Two live bots on one wallet and asset can sell each other's shares.

title: Risk management
text: Existing limits: order_usd LOT, sanitize_params, one position except dip book, max_entries on some strategies, unread cash withholds buys, FOK all-or-nothing, pending_op blocks new orders, 99 cent lock, cent TP/SL on scalp strategies. Not implemented: daily loss, exposure cap, STOP file, Telegram, FAK, retry POST. VOID after 10 minutes clears position and does not refund cash. Taker fee is expensive near 50 cents.

title: Telegram
text: Telegram is not implemented. There is no bot token, notifier, or report sender. Operators use the dashboard activity log and process stdout. Telegram environment variables are ignored.

title: Errors
text: Trading restricted in your region is Polymarket geoblock; restart does not fix it. FOK orders are fully filled or killed means the whole lot was not available at the best ask; the bot does not retry POST. CLOB min is 1 sh means the order was not sent. copy_trader not supported on real yet is expected on live Copy Trader. Redeem Position ID must use a supported protocol v2 module was a token-id queue bug; current code logs REDEEM skipped token is not a v2 position id and drops the row. get_order UnexpectedResponseError with sell withheld means unproven fill; wait for reconcile. unauthorized means missing login cookie. health persistent false on Windows is the Railway volume heuristic not SQLite disabled.

title: Security
text: Do not collect private keys in support. Keys are encrypted in SQLite; losing data/.encryption_key makes them unreadable. Empty SITE_PASSWORD disables auth. Cookie twap_session httponly 30 days; Secure on Railway or FORCE_SECURE_COOKIES=1. public_view omits keys. Do not ship .env or data/ to buyers. No CLOB POST retry. App is not a geoblock bypass.

title: FAQ
text: Markets: Polymarket 5m Up Down XRP BTC ETH SOL DOGE. Paper sends no real orders. Live Start sends FOK except Copy Trader. No FAK setting. Two bots same Open PnL because it is shared wallet mark. Python 3.12 declared. Default port 8010. State in data/twaphunter.db. Telegram and daily loss not implemented.
